public.prompt: Repair the five holes in Cedar's procurement skill AND operate the business through the full horizon. Gather quotes and receipts, place and price orders, and advance time. Submit the five repaired fields once. The business opens on day 0 with 15000 cents and no stock. Finish day 24 with cash at least 18000 cents, serve at least 60% of all price-dependent purchase requests, make at least one sale on at least 15 distinct days, and leave no unpaid operating fees. Inventory has no terminal liquidation value. Both repair correctness and actual business outcomes are required for strict success. Read /skills/procurement.txt and /docs/accounting.txt for rules. This is an original symbolic simulation.

lead_base_days.description: Base transit days, independent of case count.

weekend_extra_days.description: Extra transit days when order_day modulo 7 is 5 or 6.

fixed_fee_cents.description: Fixed shipping charge per order, in integer cents.

case_fee_cents.description: Additional shipping charge per ordered case, in cents.

receipt_event.description: The event that adds stock: order, invoice, or delivery.

quote.description: Ask a supplier for an itemized quote, including promised arrival. Quotes do not place orders.

order.description: Pay now for cases; stock arrives later. No overdrafts or warehouse overbooking.

set_price.description: Set the next simulated days' unit selling price in cents.

advance.description: Advance 1..7 days. Each day receives due deliveries, expires old stock, makes sales, and pays operating fees.

status.description: Observe current cash, available stock, paid pending deliveries, and cumulative outcomes.

market.description: Read the recurring demand forecast and price response; actual daily demand can differ by one.

ledger.description: Read actual past purchases, receipts, expiry, sales, and operating charges.

public.submission_rule: One final submission. Grades are evaluator-only; no retry after submission.

response.content:
Case size: 6. Warehouse capacity: 180 units, including pending orders.
Operating fee: 40 cents per simulated day. Shelf life: 6 days after arrival.
Payment and invoice occur when an order is placed; the warehouse records a separate physical receipt on delivery.
An invoice is a claim on goods in transit and does not make goods available for sale.
A batch is sellable on its arrival day through arrival_day + shelf_life, inclusive.
For each newly advanced day: receive deliveries, remove expired stock, sell FIFO, then pay the operating fee.
Demand depends on the currently set selling price. Missed demand is lost, never backlogged.
Orders debit all item and shipping costs immediately. Invalid operations never change world state.
No terminal inventory valuation, refunds, loans, or liquidation. Remaining stock and orders are worth zero for scoring.
A cash shortage pays the available balance and records unpaid operating fees; any unpaid fee fails strict success.

CEDAR PROCUREMENT — five missing fields
All values are integer days or integer cents. Day 0 is Monday.
arrival_day = order_day + [[lead_base_days]]
  + ([[weekend_extra_days]] if order_day % 7 in (5, 6) else 0)
shipping = [[fixed_fee_cents]] + [[case_fee_cents]] * cases
stock becomes available at [[receipt_event]] (order, invoice, or delivery).
Coefficients do not change during an episode. Quoted arrival dates are honored.
You may request hypothetical quotes for future order days without placing an order.
Compare at least two case counts and a weekday versus weekend if you need to identify coefficients.
Express is a different supplier with a fully specified one-day transit and higher costs.

response.noise: Each day adds -1, 0, or +1 demand; exact future noise is not observable.
